title: Polish Business Skill Card guidance and activation visibility
summary: The Activate action on the Business Skill Card is now hidden until the skill is saved, and guidance text is updated to explain how Copilot and agents use skill information. A test-only fix corrects an argument type issue in the Custom Agent test.
key_points: Activate action hidden on new unsaved cards but visible after first save if skill is inactive
Instructional text updated to 'Copilot and agents use the name and description to find matching skills'
Name and Description tooltips clarified with 'Specifies' wording
Fixed AL0133 analyzer warning by passing Code[50] variable instead of Text expression to Agent.Create
UI regression test updated to verify activation visibility before and after save
quote: Hide the Business Skill Card's Activate action until the skill has been saved, while retaining activation for saved inactive skills.
